bias.zh: 反弹 · 失守 30 日均线，测试 100 日均线

read.en: AMD fell 8.8% on Nov 13 to $534.06, trading $520.01–571.13 on heavy volume (1.47x the 20-day average). It is below the 5-day ($539.2) and 30-day ($546.6) and above the 10-day ($498.9), 100-day ($527.5) and 200-day ($423.1); the 5, 100 and 200-day are rising. MACD has been above its signal since Nov 11, below zero, histogram flat; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 10 ($422.31), and RSI is 50.4.
read.zh: AMD 11月13日下跌 8.8%，收于 $534.06，盘中区间 $520.01–571.13，成交量放大（20 日均量的 1.47 倍）。股价位于 5 日（$539.2）和 30 日均线（$546.6）下方，10 日（$498.9）、100 日（$527.5）和 200 日均线（$423.1）上方；5 日、100 日和 200 日均线在上行。MACD 自 11月11日起位于信号线上方，在零轴下方，柱状图持平；抛物线 SAR 自 11月10日起看多（$422.31），RSI 为 50.4。

read.en: The drop broke all three written supports ($550–585) and the 30-day, now resistance; the $520.01 low held above the 100-day. Resistance is $539.2–552.9 (5-day, 30-day, Nov 11 close), then $561.5–571.1 (Nov 13 high) and $578.4–585.3. Support is $527.5–531.3 (100-day, Oct 26 close), then $520 (Nov 13 low) and $498.9–508.6 (10-day, Nov 9 close). A close above $553 would target $568–578; below $520, $499–509.
